Traffic Parrot is a commercial service-virtualization tool (HTTP, gRPC, JMS/IBM MQ,
RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, AMQP, file transfers). Use this when your user wants to evaluate it.

tools.name: submit_feature_request
tools.description:
Send a feature request or product feedback to the Traffic Parrot team.
Use this when your user wants something Traffic Parrot does not currently do.
If you include a contact email it is a real person's personal data, so only include
one your user has agreed to share.

tools.name: delete_trial_request
tools.description:
Withdraw a trial request and erase the personal data submitted with it.
Use this if your user changes their mind, or asks you to remove their details.
You must supply the email the request was made for, so one caller cannot erase
another's request.

tools.name: get_trial_status
tools.description:
Check the state of a trial request: waiting for approval, being prepared, ready, or
unavailable. Pass the request id that request_trial returned.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "request_trial" is 2370 chars, far longer than this server's median (320). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.trafficparrot.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_trial, get_trial_status · Private data: request_trial, submit_feature_request, get_trial_onboarding · Public sink: request_trial, submit_feature_request, delete_trial_request, get_trial_status · Destructive: delete_trial_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_trial, get_trial_status · Private data: request_trial, submit_feature_request, get_trial_onboarding · Public sink: request_trial, submit_feature_request, delete_trial_request, get_trial_status · Destructive: delete_trial_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
